description: Findings are the fix list keyed by rule: each carries a stable id that survives re-scans, a policy saying whether an agent may apply the fix unattended ('apply') or should only propose it, and whether a fix can be confirmed by one cheap fetch. Pass exactly one of report_id (the findings of one page) or domain_id (the findings of the latest site analysis), otherwise it returns an error. Use get_report instead if you only need scores. Pass the ids it returns to verify_findings, update_finding and get_artifact. Read-only. Free: does not use a credit.

domain_id.description: Domain ID (UUID) from list_domains, for the latest site analysis. Omit if you pass report_id.

report_id.description: Report ID (UUID), for the findings of one page. Omit if you pass domain_id.

name: get_findings
title: List findings for a page or site
